prs.cluster_pick_reason: #3063 detects collisions via `if request_id in self._request_streams` where the key is `str(message.id)`; #3221 replaces this with a `_request_stream_key()` helper that prefixes keys with `i:`/`s:` so an int id `1` and a string id `"1"` are no longer collapsed into the same key — a case #3063's `str()`-based key does not distinguish, which #3221 documents explicitly and #3063 does not test. #3221 also closes a second collision: it guards against a JSON-RPC id equal to `GET_STREAM_KEY` (`"_GET_stream"`) hijacking the standalone GET stream's routing slot, which #3063's diff does not address. members.title: fix: skip JSON pre-parsing for str union annotations in pre_parse_json
members.author: adityuhkapoor
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: pre_parse_json() in func_metadata.py calls json.loads() on any string-valued argument whose annotation is not exactly `str` (the check was `field_info.annotation is not str`). members.title: fix(streamable-http): reject duplicate in-flight request ids
members.author: Sammy-Dabbas
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #3221: Concurrent requests using the same JSON-RPC request id silently overwrite each other's slot in `_request_streams`, cross-wiring responses (one request gets the other's payload, the other hangs). Both PRs add a check when registering a new request id and reject the second concurrent request with an error instead of overwriting the stream.
